units.source_text: 夫人想起婚期就在眼前，便心绪不宁，手忙脚乱。

en.t: The lady remembered that the wedding date was close at hand, and she grew restless and flustered.

units.source_text: 她不能安心坐定在女儿房中，只管忙忙碌碌地东奔西走。

en.t: She could not sit calmly in her daughter's room, but kept hurrying busily back and forth.

units.source_text: 常陆守从外面进来，对她滔滔不绝地讲了一大篇话，他说：

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi came in from outside and poured out a long speech to her, saying:

units.source_text: “你瞒着我，想把恋慕我女儿的人夺走，真是不通道理，浅薄之极了！

en.t: “You kept it from me and tried to steal away the man who loves my daughter; that is utterly unreasonable and shallow beyond measure!

units.source_text: 须知你那位高贵亲王家的小姐，贵公子们是不要的！

en.t: You should know that young gentlemen do not want that noble young lady from your prince's household!

units.source_text: 而我们这种不成样子的下贱人家的女儿，他们倒是要追求的呢！

en.t: But they are quite willing to pursue a daughter from a shabby, lowly family like ours!

units.source_text: 你虽然用尽心计，可是对方全然无意，却看中了另外一人。

en.t: Though you used every scheme you could think of, the man had no interest at all and chose someone else instead.

units.source_text: 既然如此，我就对他说‘悉听尊便’，答应了他。”

en.t: Since that was so, I told him, ‘Do as you please,’ and accepted his proposal.”

units.source_text: 常陆守性情粗暴，全不替对方着想，任意乱讲。

en.t: The Governor of Hitachi was rough by nature, and without the slightest consideration for the other side, he spoke recklessly as he pleased.

units.source_text: 夫人大吃一惊，一句话也不说，只觉得世间可悲之事接踵而来，眼泪即将夺眶而出，立刻返身入内。

en.t: The lady was terribly shocked and said nothing, feeling only that sorrowful events in this world were coming one after another; with tears about to spill from her eyes, she at once turned and went inside.

units.source_text: 她走到浮舟房中，看见她相貌异常娇艳，想道：

en.t: She went to Ukifune's room, saw how unusually lovely her appearance was, and thought:

units.source_text: “无论如何，她的相貌决不比别人坏。”

en.t: “Whatever else may be true, her looks are certainly no worse than anyone else's.”

units.source_text: 心中稍稍安慰，就和乳母二人谈话：

en.t: A little comforted in her heart, she began talking with the nurse, just the two of them:

units.source_text: “人心如此浅薄，实甚可悲！

en.t: “It is truly sad that people's hearts can be so shallow!

units.source_text: 我自知对于女儿个个都要一视同仁，惟有对这孩子的女婿，我特别关切，为他舍命也情愿。

en.t: I know that I ought to treat all my daughters equally, yet when it comes to this child's husband, I have cared especially deeply, enough that I would gladly give my life for him.

units.source_text: 岂知此人为了她没有父亲而欺负她，舍弃了这长姐而改娶尚未成年的幼妹，哪有这种道理？

en.t: Who would have thought that he would take advantage of her because she has no father, abandon the elder sister, and marry the younger sister who is not yet grown; what sense is there in that?

units.source_text: 我不忍看到又听到亲近人之中有这等可悲的事情。

en.t: I cannot bear to see and hear of such painful things among people close to us.

units.source_text: 常陆守却看作极有面子的事，连忙答应下来，大肆宣扬，这两人倒是志同道合的一对翁婿。

en.t: Yet the Governor of Hitachi took it as a great honor, quickly agreed, and loudly spread the news; those two are truly a like-minded father-in-law and son-in-law.

units.source_text: 我决定今后对此事绝不插嘴，想暂时离开这里，到别处去住几时才好。”

en.t: I have decided that from now on I will not say a word about this matter, and I think it would be best to leave here for a while and stay somewhere else.”

units.source_text: 说着悲叹不已。

en.t: As she spoke, she went on grieving and lamenting.

units.source_text: 乳母也很愤慨，痛恨他们欺负自家的小姐。

en.t: The nurse was also deeply indignant and bitterly hated them for mistreating their young lady.

units.source_text: 她说：“怕什么呢？

en.t: She said, “What is there to fear?

units.source_text: 断绝了这门亲事，多半是我家小姐的造化。

en.t: The breaking off of this marriage is most likely a blessing for our young lady.

units.source_text: 这少将的心地如此卑鄙，恐怕小姐这般花容月貌他也不会赏识吧。

en.t: With such a base heart, that Lesser Captain would probably fail to appreciate even our lady's flowerlike beauty.

units.source_text: 我家小姐应该嫁个知情达理、博学多才的郎君。

en.t: Our young lady should marry a gentleman who is understanding, reasonable, learned, and talented.

units.source_text: 那薰大将大人的容貌风采，我上次隐约窥见，真漂亮啊，叫人看了寿命也可延长呢！

en.t: As for Lord Kaoru the Grand General's looks and bearing, I caught a faint glimpse of him last time, and he was so beautiful that seeing him might even lengthen one's life!

units.source_text: 他如此真心爱慕小姐，夫人还不如听天由命，把小姐许给了他吧。”

en.t: Since he loves our young lady so sincerely, my lady might as well leave it to fate and promise her to him.”

units.source_text: 夫人说道：“唉，不要做这梦吧！

en.t: The lady said, “Ah, let us not dream such dreams!

units.source_text: 我听人说：这位薰大将多年来决心不娶寻常女子。

en.t: I have heard people say that for many years this Lord Kaoru was determined not to marry any ordinary woman.

units.source_text: 夕雾左大将、红梅按察大纳言、蜻蛉式部卿亲王等，都非常诚恳地要把女儿嫁给他，但他一概谢绝，终于娶得了皇上所最宠爱的二公主。

en.t: Yugiri the Left Grand General, Kobai the Inspector Grand Counselor, Prince Kagero of the Ministry of Ceremonial, and others all earnestly wished to marry their daughters to him, but he refused them all and finally married the Second Princess, whom the emperor loved most dearly.

units.source_text: 怎样十全无缺的美女，才能博得他真心的爱呢？

en.t: What kind of flawless beauty would be needed to win his true love?

units.source_text: 我只想送小姐到薰大将的母亲三公主那里去当差，让她常常和大将见面。

en.t: I only wanted to send the young lady to serve the Third Princess, Lord Kaoru's mother, so that she might often meet the general.

units.source_text: 然而，三条院地方虽好，与人争宠毕竟也很没趣。

en.t: Still, although Sanjo Palace is a fine place, competing with others for favor is dreary after all.

units.source_text: 匂亲王的夫人，世人都说她十分幸福，然而近来也遭到了忧患。

en.t: People all say that Prince Niou's wife is very happy, yet she too has lately met with sorrow.

units.source_text: 如此看来，无论如何，只有不生二心的男子，才是体面而可靠的。

en.t: Seen in this light, whatever else may be true, only a man who has no divided heart is respectable and dependable.

units.source_text: 只要看我自身，就可明白：已故的八亲王，人物原也风流潇洒，高尚优雅，然而不把我当作人看，真使我伤心啊！

en.t: One need only look at me to understand: the late Eighth Prince was indeed graceful, elegant, noble, and refined, yet he did not treat me as a person, and that truly wounded me!

units.source_text: 现在这常陆守呢，虽然无才无德，粗俗不堪，但是专志守一，从无二心，因此我得安心度送年月。

en.t: As for the present Governor of Hitachi, although he has neither talent nor virtue and is unbearably coarse, he is devoted and has no second heart, so I can pass the years in peace.

units.source_text: 有时他脾气暴躁，不讲情理，原也是讨厌的。

en.t: At times he is hot-tempered and unreasonable, which is certainly unpleasant.

units.source_text: 然而大家并不真心痛恨，遇有不称心处，互相争吵一番，过后也就无事。

en.t: But no one truly hates him; when something is displeasing, we quarrel with one another for a while, and afterward it is over.

units.source_text: 公卿大夫、皇亲国戚人家，虽然荣华富贵，但我们这种身份低微的人，进去了也是徒然。

en.t: The households of court nobles, high officials, and imperial relatives may be splendid and wealthy, but for lowly people like us, entering them would be futile.

units.source_text: 无论何事，总须与自己身份相称。

en.t: In all things, one must in the end match one's own station.

units.source_text: 如此想来，我家小姐前途实甚可悲。

en.t: Thinking of it this way, our young lady's future is truly pitiable.

units.source_text: 总得替她找个如意称心的女婿，不致受人讪笑才好。”

en.t: We must somehow find her a satisfying husband, so that she will not be laughed at by others.”
